verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Snyk integrates with source code managers (GitHub/GitLab) and supports pull-request-based workflows to surface and fix vulnerabilities, and CLI can run in CI/CD pipelines; community comments independently confirm Snyk actively opens PRs against repos (though critiquing their quality/volume). However, no explicit documentation of PR-comment or check-run UI specifics is present, and community feedback raises real friction with the PR-based workflow (excessive/point-release PRs, poor targeting) though it does confirm the feature functions rather than being broken. Missing for 10: explicit docs/screenshots of PR comment or status-check UI, and clearer independent confirmation that findings surface as inline comments/checks rather than only as fix-PRs.
